title: Polynomial divisibility is reflected by a homomorphism of fields
statement: Let $K,L$ be fields [def-weil-field], let $\iota:K\to L$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $p,q\in K[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Write $p_L,q_L\in L[X]$ for their coefficientwise images [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map]. Then $p_L\mid q_L$ if and only if $p\mid q$, where divisibility means the existence of a polynomial quotient: $p\mid q$ means $q=ph$ for some $h\in K[X]$. Zero polynomials are allowed.
